authority.scope: Existing sealed/local evidence only. No SEC requests.

question: Does any source in custody establish the FIRST hop -- permanent security identity -> effective-dated security/share-class identity -- with an independent security-class discriminator in addition to effective-dated symbol identity?
prohibited_inference: permaticker historical ticker == SEC TradingSymbol therefore same security

sources_inventoried.effective_dating_finding: CURRENT-STATE with historical-looking dates. cik_from_secfilings() regex-extracts the CIK from the `secfilings` URL of the CURRENT-state Sharadar TICKERS row -- one scalar, no time dimension -- and mr002_build_crosswalk.py:222 calls it ONCE per ticker, before intervals are painted on. Corroborated three ways: 752/754 permatickers carry exactly one CIK across all intervals; mapping_rationale for 752 rows reads 'current symbol per Sharadar TICKERS; CIK from secfilings'; the cross-check parameter is named edgar_tickers_now. The dates date the TICKER, never the CIK.
sources_inventoried.class_discriminator_finding: None. No exchange, no security title, no class column. relationship_type='share_class' (16 rows) LABELS a row as a share class but never NAMES which; its mapping_rationale is the same generic string as the 752 'direct' rows.
sources_inventoried.join_finding: Joinable to TradingSymbol only. Security12bTitle and SecurityExchangeName have no counterpart column, so the join reduces to ticker equality -- the prohibited inference.
sources_inventoried.disposition: NOT QUALIFIED (also disqualified by v1.3 control 27)

sources_inventoried.provenance: Sharadar TICKERS; permaticker landed PR #542 / PERMATICKER_EFFECTIVE_INTERVAL_V1
sources_inventoried.custody_finding: NO local or sealed artifact carries the permaticker column. All three local store DBs are pre-#542 10-column builds. The capability is code on origin/main plus a live-box measurement (21,988/22,104 = 99.47%); it is not evidence in custody.
sources_inventoried.effective_dating_finding: exchange and category are single CURRENT-STATE scalars with no history: 21,853 rows / 21,853 distinct tickers, one value each for all time. store.py:907's own docstring concedes the row 'describes the lineage holding the bare ticker NOW', and [firstpricedate, lastpricedate] bounds the validity of the ticker->permaticker answer -- NOT the exchange or class attributes.
sources_inventoried.class_discriminator_finding: PRESENT and genuine: `category` separates share classes of one issuer (GOOG=Secondary Class vs GOOGL=Primary Class; likewise BRK.A/BRK.B, CMCSA/CMCSK, LBTYA/LBTYK). This is more than ticker.
sources_inventoried.join_finding: Security12bTitle: NOT deterministically joinable. The vendor ordinal tracks primacy/liquidity, not the registrant class letter, and the correspondence INVERTS between issuers -- registrant Class A maps to vendor 'Primary Class' for Alphabet (GOOGL) but 'Secondary Class' for Berkshire (BRK.A). SecurityExchangeName: the 6-value vocabulary (NASDAQ/NYSE/NYSEMKT/NYSEARCA/BATS/OTC) IS mappable, but the value is not historically valid, so agreement at a historical accepted_at proves nothing and disagreement is uninterpretable.
sources_inventoried.disposition: NOT QUALIFIED. The independent discriminator fails on both legs -- one for want of a determinate mapping, the other for want of historical validity.
NOT QUALIFIED -- no effective dates at all, no class, n=10.
NOT QUALIFIED -- research_sector/sector_etf are SECTOR attributes, not security class; they cannot separate GOOG from GOOGL.

NOT QUALIFIED -- SEC-HEADER bytes retained to reproduce SIC decisions. SIC is an industry code, not a security class; no trading symbol, title or exchange is retained; and V3.1 is structurally SIC-blind.
NOT A SOURCE -- manifest carries objects: 0. Nothing pinned.
